column1: # Lemieux session-name roster: PWHL players, plus five CWHL players documented by the
# Hockey Hall of Fame, one filename-safe slug per line.
# Derived from public PWHL roster listings (skaters and goalies) and Hockey Hall of Fame
# player pages, snapshot of 2026-09-25. Only the slugs are kept: no names as published,
# no league ids or source URLs.
# Lemieux is not affiliated with or endorsed by the NHL, the PWHL or the Hockey Hall of Fame.
# Frozen: never reorder, insert or delete a row. A session's name is the row its id
# selects, so any change here renames sessions. Lemieux.ID.Shorthand explains the
# arithmetic and how a name is withheld without moving a row.
